messages:
ryan: quick check — PR #12891 is ready locally but linux-integration is flaky in CI. I want to land before tonight's infra patch at 22:00 UTC if possible. Anyone able to rerun the job or eyeball the failing test? small change: kv-cache eviction tweak + config default.
olivia: saw the failure earlier, looks like a race in cache_evict_test. I can try to reproduce but need ~30m.
kevin: I can trigger a targeted rerun (avoid full matrix): `./scripts/ci rerun --job=linux-integration --pr=12891`
ci-bot: Build 12891-7: linux-integration failed on `cache_evict_test` (flaky). Rerun requested by kevin.
alex: I can give a quick review after CI is green, expect only a couple nits. @ryan can you add a tiny unit test to cover the eviction edge? speeds approvals.
sam: FYI we have a rebase window tomorrow 09:00 UTC — if this can wait, that's safer than landing right before infra work.
maria: ops note — infra patch window is 21:30-22:30 UTC; we enforce a strict cutoff 21:30 (no merges 30m before). If you need it in before the patch it must be green + approved by then.
ryan: copying that cutoff. I'm going to kick Kevin's rerun now. If it passes, can someone +1? tagging @alex @olivia
olivia: starting reproduce now :hourglass_flowing_sand: will report back if I see the race locally.
kevin: kicked rerun, ci-bot shows queue. build 12891-8 queued (targeted job). cc @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: reminder — deploy freeze/enforcement starts 21:30 UTC. PRs merged before freeze must have passing CI and at least one approver.
alex: I'll watch the rerun; if it passes and Olivia confirms flake isn't reproducible I'll give a +1.
ryan: thanks — will update here. If it doesn't clear within ~25m we'll hold for the rebase window tomorrow to avoid risking a rollback during the patch.
